HIOKI | ST5520 | Insulation Tester 
 Item #: 
 ST5520 
Product Info 
Insulation tester designed for insulation resistance and voltage withstand testing of electrical devices and components according to various safety standards. It is the fastest insulation tester in the industry, delivering pass/fail assessment in as fast as 50 ms. Key features include quick discharge of residual voltage, contact check, and short-circuit check functions. The tester is ideal for battery production lines.
